findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Tower.lean:687 and :690 define `LinearMap.baseChange_id` and `LinearMap.baseChange_comp`; the PR instead uses `TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.ext fun _ _ ↦ rfl` at lines 67 and 70.
findings.fix: Prove the laws using `LinearMap.baseChange_id` and `LinearMap.baseChange_comp`, with only the bundling extensionality needed to expose those named equalities.
findings.issue: Both `map_id` (line 65) and `map_comp` (line 68) prove scalar-extension functoriality by tensor extensionality followed by `rfl`, coupling the functor to the implementation of `LinearMap.baseChange`.

findings.evidence: Comodule/PointsAction.lean:114–116 states the full equality `f.baseChange A ∘ₗ endOfPoint = endOfPoint ∘ₗ f.baseChange A`, while lines 122–136 reduce to pure tensors before invoking it.
findings.fix: After category/linear-map extensionality and rewriting the component maps, apply `Comodule.baseChange_comp_endOfPoint f.hom g.ofConv` directly (or its pointwise consequence for arbitrary `x`) without `TensorProduct.induction_on`.
findings.issue: Naturality performs tensor induction even though `Comodule.baseChange_comp_endOfPoint` already states equality of the complete linear maps; this obscures that naturality is exactly the existing lemma and adds brittle reduction steps.

summary: The functor laws rely on implementation-level reduction despite existing API lemmas, and the naturality proof unnecessarily reconstructs a supplied linear-map equality elementwise.
